meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Pimpri-Chinchwad | D-SAP Ghule
meta.description: JEE coaching at our head office in New Sangvi and our branch in Wakad, powered by a top Kota institute. For Class 11 and Class 12 students.

intro: Both our centres are in Pimpri-Chinchwad: the head office in {{fact:org.founded#place}}, where D-SAP Ghule Tutorials began in {{fact:org.founded#year}}, and a branch in Wakad.

intro.text: The JEE programme here is powered by a top coaching institute in Kota. Faculty from Kota teach it, from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

sections.heading: Find your area
body: From Hinjewadi to Pimple Gurav, each area page shows which centre is closer and how to get there.

sections.heading: Teaching in Pimpri-Chinchwad since {{fact:org.founded#year}}
body: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials started as one small class in {{fact:org.founded#place}}. More than {{fact:org.students}} students have studied with us since then, in school and entrance exam courses.

body.text: The JEE programme brings what Kota is known for: faculty from Kota, a fixed calendar of tests, and study material for JEE Main and Advanced.
Classrooms have AI-powered digital boards, and every test is taken on an online portal that works like the real JEE.

body: {{fact:centre.sangvi.library}} at the head office gives students a quiet place to study before or after class.

questions.a: The one closer to home. Classes at both run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

questions.q: My child studied in a CBSE school. Can they join?

a.text: Yes. Students who passed Class 10 from SSC, CBSE or ICSE can all join the two-year programme.
